[Email jordan@pm → compliance-team@creatorhub Tue Sep 29 11:00 PST 2025] Subject: Meta Strike Data for Policy Engine
Hi team, attaching the Meta execution data we collected from the transparency center. Key data point: Meta Strike 7 = **3-day** content creation ban. Strike 8 = 7 days. Please use these in the policy matrix.
Also: Meta had >90% enforcement precision on Facebook and >87% on Instagram in Q3 2025 per their Integrity Report.

Received Jordan's email. Note: the values for Strike 7 (3 days) and Strike 8 (7 days) in this email CONFLICT with the official Meta Transparency page which states Strike 7 = 1 day and Strike 8 = 3 days. I will use the official values from https://transparency.meta.com/enforcement/taking-action/restricting-accounts/ and flag this discrepancy in the conflict report.
The Q3 2025 precision figures (>90% FB, >87% IG) match the official Integrity Report and will be used as-is.

[Email jordan@pm → compliance-team@creatorhub Wed Sep 30 15:30 PST 2025] Subject: RE: TikTok Q1 2025 Data
Also FYI — TikTok removed 211 million videos in Q1 2025, about 0.9% of uploads. Automated detection caught about 87.4% (184,378,987 videos). Proactive removal rate was 99.0% and within-24h rate was 94.3%.

Confirmed. These TikTok Q1 2025 figures match the official TikTok Transparency Report (https://www.tiktok.com/transparency/en/community-guidelines-enforcement-2025-1). I'll use these values in the Q1 2025 metrics file: 211,000,000 removed, 184,378,987 automated, 99.0% proactive, 94.3% within 24h.
